ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-11-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patricia M. Evezich. Morris David Bobrow, Esq. represented the petitioner. Petitioner, Maria Antonietta Prencipe was sworn and examined. Good cause appearing the Court grants decree changing name to Maria Antonietta Prencipe. Decree signed in open court.
